moments.quote: An alleged intern claimed they hadn’t been paid for months, were starving, lost money trading memecoins—then later “Thanks, I have claimed fees!”
moments.why: A verified corporate handle posting what looks like personal wage complaints then a meme-coin punchline—it ignited memes, debate over unpaid interns and social media power.
